fp16.intent: test whether score-guided selective promotion recovers retrieval more efficiently than blunt uniform precision
fp16.hypothesis: promoting a small top-k subset of low-bit keys should beat uniform_2bit and approach uniform_3bit at lower effective average bits
fp16.verification: bounded NIAH sweep over promote_k and promote_bits against fp16, uniform_2bit, and uniform_3bit baselines
fp16.kill_criterion: drop if selective promotion fails to improve over uniform_2bit at matched or lower effective average bits
